picks.title: Popular open source AI developer tool Ollama raises $65M, grows to nearly 9M users
picks.why_it_matters: Ollama's massive developer adoption (176K GitHub stars, 9M users) and Benchmark backing signals that local/edge AI infrastructure is becoming a fundable category with real distribution moats.

picks.title: Paris-based AI voice startup Gradium raises $100M seed, backed by Nvidia
picks.why_it_matters: A $100M seed with Nvidia backing for an AI voice company shows strategic investors are placing big early bets on voice AI infrastructure, and European AI startups can command top-tier valuations.

picks.title: EU Parliament greenlights Chat Control 1.0
picks.why_it_matters: This regulatory shift requiring message scanning in the EU creates both compliance burdens for messaging startups and potential opportunities for privacy-preserving communication and encryption infrastructure plays.
